dimensions.assessment: Affects state and local environmental agencies and populations within designated severe or extreme ozone nonattainment areas or serious particulate matter areas.
dimensions.evidence: with respect to any nonattainment area that is classified under section 181 as a Severe Area or an Extreme Area for ozone or under section 188 as a Serious Area for particulate matter

dimensions.assessment: Relieves states and local sources from federal sanctions and fees if specific demonstrations regarding uncontrollable emissions are made.
dimensions.evidence: no sanction or fee under section 179 or 185 shall apply with respect to a State... if the State demonstrates

dimensions.assessment: Waives potential financial penalties and fees for states failing to attain national ambient air quality standards under qualifying conditions.
dimensions.evidence: no sanction or fee under section 179 or 185 shall apply

dimensions.assessment: Amends sections of the Clean Air Act regarding area designations, penalty exemptions, and periodic demonstrations.
dimensions.evidence: Section 179B of the Clean Air Act (42 U.S.C. 7509a) is amended

dimensions.assessment: Permanent statutory change to the Clean Air Act, requiring renewals of state demonstrations every 5 years to maintain exemptions.
dimensions.evidence: the State involved shall renew the demonstration required by subsection (a) at least once every 5 years.

missing_information: Specific economic or administrative cost estimates for preparing state demonstrations every five years.
importance_detail.rationale: The bill amends the Clean Air Act to exempt certain nonattainment areas from penalties and fees under specific conditions related to outside emissions, exceptional events, and unmanageable mobile sources.

Res. 1156) expressing support for tax policies that support working families.
